config.purpose: Measure sustained native M3 concurrency with production Tavern prompt/schema; transport-only, no domain effects.

cases.source: 这是第一次讨论周末安排，城市与出发地点尚未确定。用户有120分钟和50元，需要原路返回，并保留20分钟休息。
cases.request: 给出一份可调整的散步安排，恰好三条 Markdown 无序列表：时间分配、费用上限、需要确认的条件。不要编造真实地名或共同经历；总计不超过限制，每条只用一句话。

source.limitations: External dependencies are frozen only when the adapter supplies source_manifest().

manifest.scope: Thread-safe read-only proposal/native HTTP capacity; no domain commit or independent quality score.

rolling_60_seconds_at_429_admission.interpretation: Usage is final reported usage of requests admitted in this interval, including requests unfinished at rejection. This is not the supplier billing window; it cannot identify concurrency, RPM or TPM as the cause. No error body or quota headers were retained.

preliminary_invalid_runs.reason: Rejected proposal repair stopped the load window early.
Repair output budget mismatch stopped the load window early; rejection was moved before transport reservation in v3.

conclusions.scope: Live M3 requests using production Tavern prompt/schema/decoder and one repeated synthetic short walking-plan sample. No domain commit or independent semantic quality certification. Warm cached prefixes were observed. Results do not establish limits for long Study, Planning, image or mixed workloads. Concurrency 5, 6 and 7 were not tested.
conclusions.control: Original autoscale control restored; provider_overload stop retained. No further live requests issued.
